intent_en: To illustrate the critical consequences of an outbreak overwhelming healthcare resources, specifically how infection rates exceeding system capacity lead to untreated deaths and further system collapse.
previous_intent: To illustrate the severe consequences of an outbreak overwhelming healthcare systems, including untreated patients and a decline in system capacity.
narration_support: people will die untreated and as more health care workers get sick themselves the capacity of health care systems falls even further.
chart_support: An area chart plotting Infections against Time, showing a large infection peak (labeled Outbreak) rising significantly above the horizontal line representing the Capacity of Healthcare System.
evidence_note: The narration describes the negative outcomes (deaths, falling capacity) while the chart visualizes the cause (infections peaking well above the healthcare capacity line).
